verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a terminal emulator, since one could manage persisted scrollback, session restore or history. The pack documents none for Ghostty. The only related items are a configurable in-memory scrollback size (community tip) and macOS window state recovery, which are adjacent features, not documented retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
